changes.question: For the Hawaii ERS 2017 PE RFP notice and 2022 PE RFP, SBCERS 2020 PE RFP, TRS Illinois FY25 PE RFP, Baltimore BCERS alternatives RFP, and Missouri LAGERS private-markets RFP, what minimum experience is required of the primary/lead consultant or, for SBCERS, at least one key professional assigned to the account?
changes.gold_answer: Hawaii ERS 2017 PE notice: at least seven years of domestic and international investment consulting/management experience with public pension plans. Hawaii ERS 2022 PE RFP: at least seven years providing domestic and international private equity/debt consulting to public pension plans. SBCERS 2020: at least one key assigned professional has ten years recommending institutional PE investment programs, including three years with the current firm; this is not expressly a lead-only rule. TRS Illinois FY25: the primary consultant has at least three years of PE consulting to public/private pension funds or other highly comparable relevant experience. Baltimore BCERS: primary consultant at least five years of DB public-pension consulting and three years with the firm. Missouri LAGERS: lead consultant at least five years in a lead role recommending private-market investments to US public pension funds.
